=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md: lines 529-542 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pickup keeps deduplication state only in session working memory, so archiving or restarting the pickup can cause the same ongoing stall to be reported again.
  WHY: A stuck fixer session can trigger duplicate PushNotifications and duplicate comments on the same `ai:permission-prompt` issue on every hourly pickup until the stall clears.
- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md: lines 170-175 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not address that a fixer stuck on a permission prompt never reaches the end-of-session prompt-report step, leaving the janitor without the actual pending prompt text.
  WHY: An operator triaging the resulting `ai:permission-prompt` issue can identify the stuck session but not which command was waiting for approval.
- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md: lines 685-687 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan adds `PushNotification` to the pickup's Tool Access list without explicitly stating that the pickup's settings allowlist must include this tool.
  WHY: Without the `PushNotification` allow rule, a stall notification can prompt for permission and stall the pickup or be silently denied in Auto mode.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md: lines 529-542 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The D12 deduplication state lives only in the pickup session's working memory; if that session is archived or restarted, the same stall can be reported again.
  WHY: A stuck fixer session blocked on a permission prompt can produce duplicate Telegram pushes and duplicate comments on the same `ai:permission-prompt` issue on every hourly pickup until the stall clears.
- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md: lines 170-175 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not address that a fixer stuck on a permission prompt never reaches its end-of-session `permission_prompts.py file` step, and the janitor's session title and `task_summary` omit the actual prompt text.
  WHY: An operator triaging the `ai:permission-prompt` issue opened for a stuck fixer cannot tell which command was waiting for approval, only which session was stuck.
- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md: lines 685-687 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: D12 adds `PushNotification` to the pickup's Tool Access list without explicitly stating whether that tool is allow-listed in `.claude/settings.json`.
  WHY: If the `PushNotification` allow rule is missing, every stall notification can prompt for permission and stall the pickup or be silently denied in Auto mode.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
